SELECT count(DISTINCT T1.id_student) FROM studentAssessment AS T1 INNER JOIN assessments AS T2 ON T1.id_assessment = T2.id_assessment WHERE T2.code_module = 'BBB' AND T2.code_presentation = '2013J' AND T2.assessment_type = 'TMA' GROUP BY T1.id_student HAVING count(DISTINCT T2.id_assessment) = (SELECT count(*) FROM assessments WHERE code_module = 'BBB' AND code_presentation = '2013J' AND assessment_type = 'TMA')
